hypotheses.P0_full_weight_tensor_is_exact: The full rank-96 state passed through the native bilinear weights has effect fidelity at least 0.9999 in every status, template, and run.
hypotheses.P1_rank48_pca_address_is_sufficient: The discovery-frozen rank-48 state subspace executed through native weights reaches selected held-out-template fidelity at least 0.80 in every run.
hypotheses.P2_rank32_pca_address_is_sufficient: Rank 32 reaches selected held-out-template fidelity at least 0.70 in every run.
hypotheses.P3_rank48_is_near_saturated: Rank 64 improves selected held-out-template fidelity by less than 0.05 over rank 48 in every run.
hypotheses.P4_pca_address_beats_random_subspaces: Rank-48 PCA fidelity exceeds the 95th percentile of 20 random rank-48 subspaces by at least 0.15 in every run.
hypotheses.P5_fact_specific_residual_is_captured: Rank 48 reaches selected oracle-relation-answer-residual write R-squared at least 0.50 in every run.
hypotheses.P6_arbitrary_and_rule_addresses_have_sim: Selected rank-48 held-out-template fidelity is within 0.15 of unselected fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.P7_address_subspace_transfers_templates: Selected rank-48 fidelity differs by at most 0.10 between templates 0 and 6 in every run.
hypotheses.P8_signal_gate_passes: Every status, template, and run has at least 64 effectful examples.
